correctness.rationale: For STAB(K_p,q), p,q≥2, primitive facet normals are -e_i,-f_j,e_i+f_j. Their signed reduced graph incidence matrix is totally unimodular: active cone smooth iff its facet graph is a forest. Cycles avoiding the root force an upper-equality 4-cycle T_{I,J}; root cycles force one of A_i={x_i=1} or B_j={y_j=1}; converse nonsimplicial cone ranks show all are minimal component families. Facet counts are p+q+C(p,2)C(q,2). The dual saturated semigroup at A_i has degree-a Hilbert function (a+1)^q, cone over (P1)^q with Hilbert–Samuel multiplicity q!, and analogously p! at B_j; T_{I,J} has 4 primitive rays rank 3 and conifold uv−wz, multiplicity 2. Independent vertex-mask exact face and rank enumeration confirmed all predicted maximal singular strata for (2,2),(2,3),(3,3),(2,4).
residual_risks: Only generic transverse reduced singular-support statement; not scheme-theoretic singular structure or intersections.

Its closed formula for all irreducible singular components and complete generic Segre versus node local models constitute a structural specialisation of general tree criteria; factorial multiplicities and the unique equidimensional boundary are reusable invariants.
